text:
Sima: AuroraEdge returned their checklist. They want a perf POC next Tue: mixed traffic 60% generation / 40% embeddings, target sustained 130 rps, p95 < 280ms, p99 < 550ms. Also need a 50M tokens/mo cost estimate and confirmation on customer-managed KMS. Can we run this on Dedicated?

Cal: Yes. I'll request infra. @Omar can you own the runbook and load plan? Nina, can you prep the CMK blurb?

Omar: I got it. Initial plan: small warmup (5k short prefixes) -> Poisson-style ramp (to avoid synchronized bursts): step rates 30 -> 70 -> 100 -> 130 with 12m per step and a 25m soak at target. Capture p50/p95/p99, error rate, tokens consumed, and GPU telemetry. We'll try fp16 and an int8 run.

Omar: Repro snippet (vegeta/vegeta attack style):
```bash
# warmup
seq 1 5000 | xargs -n1 -P20 -I{} curl -s -X POST https://redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"lite-13b","input":"hi","max_tokens":8}' >/dev/null
# poisson-like sweep using vegeta ramp helper (pseudo)
vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=30/s -duration=12m | vegeta report -type=json > r30.json
vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=70/s -duration=12m | vegeta report -type=json > r70.json
# repeat for 100/130, then soak at 130 for 25m
```

Nina: CMK: yes — Dedicated and Private support customer-managed keys (KMS). HSM-backed keys in Private installs. I'll attach a short compliance note (SOC2/ISO summary) and where to get redacted evidence.

Cal: alloc-bot, book a dedicated-small (2x GPU slices) window for 2026-04-14 11:00 UTC for 3h.

alloc-bot: Allocation created: dedicated-small start 2026-04-14T11:00:00Z duration 3h id alloc-ef21.

Omar: Pricing ballpark: quick scenarios in runbook. Assumptions: avg tokens/gen=100, avg tokens/embed=16, mix 60/40. Hosted ~ $0.00072/token -> ~$36k/mo for 50M. Dedicated 2-GPU amortized incl infra & ops ~ $19k-24k/mo at 60-80% util. 3-GPU headroom ~ $28k-34k. I'll enumerate utilization and quantization assumptions.

Sima: Runbook checklist: 1) prewarm 10m, 2) poisson ramp 48m total, 3) soak 25m, 4) capture vegeta/wrk logs + prometheus snapshot + GPU telemetry, 5) abort if p99>950ms or error rate>2% or GPU mem>90%.

Omar: Deliverables after run: r30.json, r70.json, r100.json, r130.json, soak.json, prom-snapshot.json, GPU telemetry dump, and a 1-page exec summary with graphs (RPS, p50/p95/p99, tokens, cost per million). I'll also note fp16 vs int8 throughput differences.

Cal: If tail looks bad, include mitigation options in the customer packet: smaller model, quantized variant, or adding a third GPU slice. Show cost tradeoffs.

Nina: I'll attach the CMK/rotation/audit note and pointer to SOC2 redacted report afterwards.

Sima: Great. Ping here when you start the run so CS and customer-facing folks can watch. Demo Fri pending green. :thumbsup:

Omar: Will post artifacts in this thread within 30m of run completion.
